gates.requiredScope: The reviewed standalone intake, authoring receipt, Ready review, feature identity, branch, accepted hashes, run state, and current MergeAndSync authority remain aligned without mutating the completed delivery series.
gates.rationale: Feature 047 is independently authorized after a completed series and requires a complete standalone lineage.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any intake, receipt, review, feature, branch, authority, artifact hash, task, or run-state drift.

gates.requiredScope: The canonical audit outputs retain 12 Feature-044 decisions, 157 crosswalk rows, all auxiliary inventories, 988 mechanical references, at least 50 semantic traces, and derived finding counts under positive and malformed-data tests.
gates.rationale: Deterministic cardinality, relation, and negative-fixture proof is the primary audit acceptance contract.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any audit input, renderer, test, finding, crosswalk, inventory, reference, or output change.

gates.requiredScope: The completed ten-member intake series and the separately reviewed active intake validate without lifecycle, receipt, review, feature, feature-authorization, shell-parity, or checkout-write drift.
gates.rationale: The first remote head exposed a stale standalone-intake assumption that now has direct and cross-platform regression proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any intake collection, series lifecycle, receipt, review, alignment validator, wrapper, workflow, or supported-platform change.

gates.requiredScope: German-first and English-second CEFR-B2 audit documentation builds through DocFX and remains usable through the Playwright and Axe text-first accessibility path.
gates.rationale: Feature 047 publishes learner-facing audit evidence and updates project statistics.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any audit report, statistics, navigation, language, accessibility, or DocFX input change.

gates.requiredScope: Whitespace, formatting, source hashes, closed changed-path scope, statistics, secrets, dependencies, supply-chain checks, and agent surfaces remain valid without generated-output drift.
gates.rationale: An evidence-only audit still requires repository-integrity and secure-delivery proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any changed path, formatting, source hash, statistic, secret, dependency, generated output, or agent surface.

gates.requiredScope: The exact reviewed feature head is pushed, every mandatory GitHub technical check passes, the independent semantic review completes, no actionable review thread remains, and provider-neutral PreMerge evidence validates before merge.
gates.rationale: Remote delivery and any approval-only bypass must remain bound to the exact reviewed head.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any pushed head, check suite, review, comment, thread, provider response, or delivery-authority change.

gates.requiredScope: Product runtime, public API, package, project, dependency, example, or historical-source behavior validation.
gates.rationale: The final Feature-047 scope changes audit evidence and repository governance validation only; remote baseline builds are supplemental regression evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any product, API, package, project, dependency, example, or historical-source path enters the delivery set.
